name: Tüskevár (Hungary)
description: Blue field with a light grey triangle descending from the top edge to a point at the bottom centre, charged in the triangle with the municipal arms of Tüskevár (a blue shield with a red-clad figure holding a sabre) below the name TÜSKEVÁR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: inverted triangle from the top edge
